course_disclosure_completeness.details: The candidate document provides all required website disclosure sections specified by Blueprint Box 012 and the unique blueprint: page title and summary, course purpose, audience and prerequisites, observable learning objectives, detailed agenda/content, schedule, delivery mode and venue, quota, fee, registration status and deadlines, synthetic instructor code, disabled registration CTA, sample refund policy, privacy disclosure, accessibility disclosure, FAQ, release HOLD checklist, and internal traceability appendix.

actionable_usefulness.details: The text constitutes a comprehensive, production-structured course page specification rather than a generic outline or uninstantiated form template, fully detailing information architecture and copy blocks.

agenda_arithmetic.details: Teaching sessions (20 + 25 + 25 + 30 + 35 + 35 = 170 min) plus 10 min break exactly equal 180 min total schedule window (09:30–12:30). Figures are mutually consistent across Section 5, Section 6, Section 7, Table 1, and Table 4.

sample_synthetic_boundaries.details: Page-level watermarks ('SAMPLE／SYNTHETIC／CANDIDATE／未核准／未公開／報名關閉') appear at header, Section 0, Section 14 (HOLD), Section 15, and Appendix A. State CANDIDATE_SAMPLE_SYNTHETIC_NOT_APPROVED_NOT_PUBLIC is strictly maintained.

fact_register_traceability.details: Shared facts (S-004 to S-017) align with the shared register from 0016_R07, and document-specific facts (S17-001 to S17-015) are systematically indexed and tracked to responsible roles and real replacement sources in Tables 2, 3, and 4.

unsupported_actual_claims.details: No claims of actual execution, official government endorsement, real student outcomes, commercial transactions, or approved legal terms are made. Clear disclaimers appear throughout sections 0, 1.3, 4, 8, 9, 10, 11, 12, and 13.

inactive_example_invalid_urls.details: All URLs and email endpoints strictly use the RFC 2606 reserved '.invalid' top-level domain (https://example.invalid/courses/sample-0017, https://example.invalid/register/sample-0017, course-info@example.invalid) and are explicitly documented as inactive/unreachable.

disabled_registration_payment.details: Registration status is explicitly '關閉／停用' with CTA labeled '立即報名（已停用）'. Payment is explicitly flagged as zero-transaction sample ($1,200 NTD synthetic sample, no billing, no receipt, no contract created).

privacy_accessibility_truthfulness.details: Sections 11 and 12 truthfully state that personal data is not collected and accessibility testing/certification is not claimed, detailing requirements needed prior to production release.
